description: Look up field names, descriptions, units and band values. Search rather than pulling everything (~230 KB): search="bull flag", category=patterns, level=market. Names are <group>_<name>[_<unit>]; bands end in a category word (_zone, _state, _trend), raw numbers in a unit (_pct, _ratio, _usd). Every band (tracked: true) also has _prev, _periods, _flips_recent_count, _flips_lookback and _stability, usable as fields and filters; lookups omit those rows unless markers=true. Over 25 matches lists names only: search again by exact name for a description.

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

compact.description: Name, type, values and description only.

level.description: ticker = per-asset fields; market = market_*/macro_*; model = model_* (TickerDB's trading models).

search.description: Words that must all appear in name, category or description.

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

name: get_schema
